_comment: Player settings, in menu order (Esc -> Settings; then Reset to defaults, Controls, Back). kind: bool (on / off), choice (one of options; option_labels for the menu, values for what the option stands for), range (whole numbers min..max in steps, shown with an optional unit). A new setting only needs an entry here and someone who reads Game.settings. Game.apply_settings() puts them into effect the moment they change.
_window: The window as a whole multiple of the 480 x 270 picture (only while the display is a window); a size bigger than the screen drops to the biggest that fits.
_text_speed: How fast the text box writes: values scale data/text_box.json's letters per second; 0 shows the whole line at once.

always_run.label: Always run
always_run._note: On: the farmer runs, the run key walks.

_volume: Volumes: range entries with a bus are read by the Sfx autoload (Sfx.set_volume(bus, value / max)); the menu draws them as sliders.
